text: タケシは　めったに　わらわないが　いちど　わらいだすと　とまらなく　なる　らしい！

structure.jp: タケシは　めったに　わらわないが
いちど　わらいだすと
とまらなく　なる　らしい！

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever that happens, this always follows'. わらいだすと = 'once he starts laughing'.

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says this is something the speaker heard, not something he knows for sure. とまらなく なる らしい = 'apparently he becomes unable to stop'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が right after a finished statement means 'but', not the usual が that follows the doer. わらわないが = 'he doesn't laugh, but'.
